data.narrative:
CubeSpace is a growth-stage company in Space & Aerospace founded by Mike-Alec Kearney, Willem Jordaan, and Jako Gerber. The sector comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard valuation triangulation methods encounter material constraints here. Peer-median benchmarking is not applicable: while 14 same-sector peers exist in Space & Aerospace, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier yields insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3 required for statistical reliability). Public-comp anchoring via EV/Revenue is similarly inapplicable; the Space & Aerospace public median trades at 27.4x revenue across 6 tickers, but CubeSpace's revenue is not on file, as is typical for private companies.

Without disclosed revenue, operating metrics, or a sufficiently dense comparable set at matching stage and scale, conventional quantitative valuation cannot be performed on the provided data. Any range assignment would require either (1) CubeSpace's own financial disclosure, (2) access to a denser peer set at growth stage within aerospace, or (3) application of alternative methods (DCF, scenario modeling) contingent on forward guidance or operational benchmarks not present here. The analysis underscores the opacity of frontier-tech private valuations and the necessity of direct company diligence to establish defensible pricing.
